name: Open site with two-account follow gate
description: Verifies the site opens behind a gate requiring both TikTok follow actions before entry.
expected: Both accounts are shown and the Enter website button becomes enabled only after both follow buttons are opened.

name: Enter and run device tuner
description: Verifies the primary tuner workflow after the access gate is completed.
steps: Wait for the benchmark to finish
expected: The tuner opens and shows device facts, benchmark results, and sensitivity values.

name: Rate the website
description: Verifies the five-star rating component can be selected and submitted.
steps: Complete the two TikTok follow actions
expected: Five stars are selectable and submission changes the button to a thank-you state.

name: Switch play style and copy settings
description: Verifies changing play style updates the profile and settings can be copied.
steps: Complete the two TikTok follow actions
expected: Rush sensitivity values are displayed and the copy button confirms the settings were copied.
